summary: Example task prints RouterOS resource statistics with routeros_command running /system resource print.
questions: How do I check RouterOS resource usage with Ansible?

answer_card.title: RouterOS resource statistics
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
- name: Display resource statistics (routeros)
  community.network.routeros_command:
    commands: /system resource print
  register: routeros_resources
  when: ansible_network_os == 'community.network.routeros'
```
